svg.title: Reduction in distinct correct representations by invariant, ACGN v3.1
svg.desc: Seventeen panels show all 181 invariant pools on the same zero to 100 percent scale. Teal is the reduction already present in v3, gold the additional v3.1 reduction. Exact counts and percentages are in per-invariant.csv.

g.text: ACGN / ALLOY4FUN CORRECT REFERENCE POOLS / v3.1
How much does each invariant shrink?
4,496 distinct ASTs become 2,028 canonical forms across 181 pools: 54.89% fewer representations overall.
* = only one AST to begin with
